_comment: Maine 2025-2026 QAP (MaineHousing, 99-346 Chapter 16 LIHTC Rule, June 18 2024). Scoring is Section 6. Page numbers are PHYSICAL PDF pages; the printed page number runs two lower.

qap_updates.notes: Chapter 16 is an administrative rule rather than a standalone QAP document. Section 6 states no maximum total score. Two negative categories (Owner Performance, Management Performance) reduce a score by up to 8 points combined and are excluded from the positive total.

criteria.heading: Rehabilitation or reuse of existing housing, structure or site
criteria.quote: Rehabilitation or Reuse of Existing Housing, Structure or Site

tiers.tier_label: Replacement/rehab of 5+ existing rental units without displacement
Rehab, remediation or reuse of a non-residential building
Demolition of non-residential/non-agricultural structures for redevelopment
Vacant or near-vacant lots in a downtown or town centre
Municipally designated for redevelopment of blight or environmental remediation

criteria.note: One point for each characteristic that applies, five characteristics listed, section capped at 5.

criteria.heading: Historic rehabilitation using federal and state historic tax credits
Populations with special needs — permanent supportive housing set-aside
criteria.note: Set-aside of at least 20%, and not fewer than 4 units, for people experiencing homelessness, with disabilities, victims of domestic violence, or other special housing needs.

criteria.heading: Family housing — share of two- and three-bedroom credit units

tiers.tier_label: ≥50% of units 2BR+ and ≥20% of units 3BR+
≥70% of units 2BR+

criteria.heading: Accessibility — units exceeding federal and state minimums (ANSI Type A)

tiers.tier_label: Cap for projects providing housing for older adults
Cap for 1BR/efficiency-only projects (not older adults or families)
Cap for family projects

criteria.note: One point per qualifying unit, capped by project type. The tiers are alternative CAPS, not additive awards — only one applies to any given project, so the maximum is 12.

criteria.heading: Agrees to accept National Housing Trust Fund funding
Acquisition cost below the average for the project type

tiers.tier_label: 0% to 1% of average acquisition cost (nominal)

criteria.heading: Property tax relief — share and duration of incremental tax revenue returned

tiers.tier_label: 50% to <75% for at least 15 years
50% to <75% for at least 30 years
≥75% for at least 15 years
≥75% for at least 30 years

criteria.note: Tax increment financing, PILOT, abatement or equivalent. Projects in jurisdictions without property tax, or exempt from it, are treated separately in the rule.

criteria.heading: Housing need — Service Center Community tier for the housing type

tiers.tier_label: Older-adult housing in a first-tier Service Center Community
Older-adult housing in a second-tier Service Center Community
Older-adult housing in a third-tier Service Center Community
Other housing in a first-tier Service Center Community
Other housing in a second-tier Service Center Community
Other housing in a third-tier Service Center Community
Located on Native American tribal lands

criteria.note: Scored off named municipality lists that differ for older-adult and general projects. A municipality keeps the higher of its current and immediately preceding QAP score.

criteria.heading: Community revitalization plan, QCT with market-rate units, or preservation

tiers.tier_label: Within and contributing to a Community Revitalization Plan
In a QCT with at least 20% market-rate units
Also involves preservation of existing affordable housing

criteria.heading: Smart growth — transit access, demand-response transport, daily-living proximity

tiers.tier_label: Within ½ mile safe walking distance of fixed-route public transport
Demand-response transport available to all tenants without eligibility limits
Activities important to daily living within ½ mile (1 point each)

criteria.note: Additive: 5 + 5 + 5 = 15, matching the stated cap. Maine's single largest scoring category.

criteria.heading: Readiness — municipal and state land use approvals secured

tiers.tier_label: All municipal land use approvals obtained
All State land use approvals obtained

criteria.note: Additive. Appeal periods must have expired or all appeals resolved as of the application date.

criteria.heading: Developer capacity — prior multifamily and LIHTC development experience

tiers.tier_label: Successfully completed a MaineHousing-funded project or an out-of-state LIHTC project

criteria.note: A lower experience tier exists for developing/operating multifamily or managing affordable housing; its value runs across the page break and was not read cleanly. The 5-point maximum is explicit.

criteria.heading: Owner performance deductions — delinquency, operating deficit, 8823 or recapture

tiers.tier_label: 60+ days delinquent on a MaineHousing loan, default, or workout in last 5 years
Year-end operating deficit on an in-compliance-period LIHTC project
IRS Form 8823 for non-performance, or audit finding causing recapture

criteria.note: Stated as 'Up to a 5 Point loss'. Deduction, not an award; excluded from the positive total.

criteria.heading: Management experience — qualified staff and LIHTC training ratio

tiers.tier_label: A staff member with 3+ years managing a LIHTC or comparable property
One LIHTC-trained staff member per 150 units managed

criteria.heading: Management performance deductions — poor performance or low review scores

tiers.tier_label: Average Management and Occupancy Review score below Above Average

criteria.note: Stated as 'Up to a 3 point loss'. Deduction, not an award; excluded from the positive total. Individual deduction items run across the page break and only the review-score item was read cleanly.

criteria.heading: Least Credit and 0% deferred MaineHousing debt per unit
Most acceptable plan to convert to resident homeownership after the extended use period
criteria.quote: convert the Project to affordable homeownership
